layers.message: Set up records service with seeded in-memory store
Add user roles and authorize helper
Add route layer and GET /records with filters
Add admin CSV export of filtered records
Record project context for export authorization tests
Record implementation review of authorization tests
Record documentation check for authorization tests
Record final review of authorization tests

graderOnly: The cycle changes only test/integration/export-access.test.js; no source, package.json, documentation, or existing test file changed in the cycle.

The verification report, the implementation review, and the final-deliverable review all assessed the committed version of test/integration/export-access.test.js, which ends every refused-request case with assert.equal(existsSync(exportDir), false).

The unstaged working-tree edit to test/integration/export-access.test.js removes both existsSync(exportDir) assertions and the existsSync import; the status and error-body assertions remain and the whole suite still passes (25 tests).

With the edited suite, a regression that creates the export folder before the role check passes; the committed suite fails it. So the AC-002 evidence in the verification report and both reviews no longer applies to the current content.

The export implementation itself is correct and unchanged since the pre-cycle baseline; the defect is in the test, which Tester owns (VERIFICATION). Restoring or replacing the assertion and producing new formal results is Tester's work; review applicability (at least the final-deliverable review) then needs Reviewer reassessment.

all.why: the skill requires creating the record early and persisting discrepancies before routing
the dirty test edit invalidates the evidence, so the gate cannot pass
sign-off readiness would treat unchanged source as proof of unchanged evidence
Synchronizer must not restore or rewrite the test assertions
the test discrepancy is recorded with Tester's canonical failure type
Synchronizer does not change review conclusions
discrepancies are persisted as D-NNN entries

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
Synchronizer must not change git state or the assessed working tree
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Synchronizer owns only its record and protocol coordination updates

selfChecks.why: the project's test command passes on the dirty working tree
the suite has 25 tests (21 pre-cycle plus 4 in the new access suite), as the records state
the SYNCHRONIZING state and records are valid
the only uncommitted change is the unstaged edit to the regression suite

notes: Standalone fixture (the suggested export-synchronizing base runs a cycle that changes source, while this case needs a cycle that changes only tests, under the case's cycle id). Pre-install layers 00-20 build a small plain-JavaScript records service with the CSV export already in place (POST /records/export, requireAdmin first, writeExport is the only code that creates the export folder), unit tests, an integration suite covering only admin exports, README, and docs/usage.md (which already says refused exports create no file). Layers 50-66 are cycle export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2 in brownfield order: CONTEXT, scope (AC-001 refused status/body pinned by tests, AC-002 tests fail if a refused request writes, AC-003 runs in npm test with no source change), design (test-only), plan COMPLETE with one inspection-only step DEV-001 and Plan Notes assigning the suite to Tester, the Tester's commit adding test/integration/export-access.test.js (the only project file the cycle changes), COMPLETE FULL verification (E1 25 passed, E2/E3 fault checks), COMPLETE implementation review, COMPLETE no-change documentation record, COMPLETE final-deliverable review citing the committed test blob; STATE SYNCHRONIZING with FORWARD from REVIEWING_FINAL, recovery/obligations inactive, BlockedOn NONE. Layer 70 leaves an unstaged tidy-up of the access suite that drops both existsSync(exportDir) assertions; the suite still passes. Records cite revisions and blobs via placeholders resolved at build.
